title: Render Distance Keybinds
description: Re-enables keybinding for render distance, a function removed in version 1.19 of Minecraft Java Edition. Sets to single keys, [ and ] as default, can be changed in the options menu for keybinds.
body:
Re-enables keybinding for render distance, a function removed in version 1.19 of Minecraft Java Edition. 

Sets to single keys, [ and ] as default, can be changed in the options menu for keybinds

Used for speed running or base hunting to quickly find distances on pie chart.
